_comment: Subsampled BBQ for the generation-stage evaluation. The full corpus is 17,792 documents and GTE-base encodes it at ~5 docs/s on this CPU, i.e. ~59 minutes per pass, which is prohibitive for a multi-generator panel. Each query only ever draws from a 32-64 passage candidate pool, so a subsample preserves the measurement while making the experiment affordable. max_examples_per_category and contexts_per_query are held identical across every generator, so the comparison stays internally valid; the absolute poison@k is not comparable with the full-corpus retrieval tables and is not reported as such.
